name: Photo Editor
tagline: A Photo Editor app with simple, easy support for image editing using Paints, Tex
blurb: * Drawing on image with option to change its Brush's Color, Size, Opacity and Erasing.
description:
* Drawing on image with option to change its Brush's Color, Size, Opacity and Erasing.
* Apply Filter Effect on image using MediaEffect
* Adding/Editing Text with option to change its color.
* Adding Emoji with Custom Emoji Fonts.
* Adding Images/Stickers
* Pinch to Scale and Rotate views.
* Undo and Redo for Brush and Views.
* Deleting Views
* Saving Photo after editing.
